{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Instead of reducing the accuracy by 5% per rank, each rank increases spread by a specific value per rank depending on the weapon.
*Damage increase stacks additively with that of {{M|Hornet Strike}} and {{M|Augur Pact}}.
*Added spread is not affected by bonuses that increase accuracy, such as {{M|Reflex Draw}} or {{M|Targeting Subsystem}}.
**For example, a {{Weapon|Lato}} with {{M|Magnum Force}} and {{M|Reflex Draw}} will have a max deviation of {{Math|{{Tooltip|10.5|Lato's Max Deviation}} {{mul}} (1 - {{M|Reflex Draw|40%}}) + {{M|Magnum Force|5.5}}|t=y|bf=y|round=0.1}} degrees.
*Causes beam of all continuous weapons to noticeably wobble.

==Tips==
*If a pistol already has a max rank {{M|Hornet Strike}}, adding a max rank Magnum Force represents only a {{Math|2.65 / (1 + 2.2 + 1.65)|p=y|approx=y}} increase in damage per shot, compared to a 90% increase for a max rank uncommon elemental mod such as {{M|Heated Charge}}.
*However, the {{Weapon|Angstrum}} can benefit from this, as it allows its charged shots to cover a larger area at the cost of limiting long-range capabilities. Alongside it are other secondaries such as {{Weapon|Zakti}}, {{Weapon|Talons}}, {{Weapon|Castanas}}, {{Weapon|Staticor}}, {{Weapon|Stug}}, {{Weapon|Sonicor}}, {{Weapon|Pox}}, and {{Weapon|Kulstar}} when equipped with [[Multishot]] mods.
*This mod also fixes the inaccuracy bug that occurs when using multishot on the {{Weapon|Castanas}} and {{Weapon|Sancti Castanas}} at low level, but it's still advised to max the mod anyway for extra damage and higher spread on the Castanas, leading to more crowd control.
*This should only be used on weapons that already have {{M|Hornet Strike}} installed, as the bonuses gained from this mod are greater than Magnum Force and comes with no accuracy penalty. Also take {{M|Augur Pact}} into consideration as it costs less mod capacity without the accuracy penalty.

==Trivia==
*When it was first released, Magnum Force increased ''recoil'' as well as damage. However the recoil penalty did not affect recoil-less weapons ({{Weapon|Acrid}}, and {{Weapon|Embolist}}, among others). This was confirmed to be unintentional in [http://www.twitch.tv/warframe/b/469098182 Warframe Prime Time - Episode 2 (9:40)]. The mod's effects were changed in {{ver|10.4}} to give weapons an accuracy penalty instead of a recoil penalty.
*"Magnum Force" is the name of the second movie in the "Dirty Harry" series of films starring Clint Eastwood.
*Prior to {{ver|24.2.10}}, Magnum Force provided +66% damage and -33% accuracy at max rank.

{{ModBox}}
'''Maim''' is a [[mod]] that increases {{D|Slash}} damage of a pistol by 20% per rank for a maximum of 120% at rank 5.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mods#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Effect
! [[Mods#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +20% || 6
|-
| 1 || +40% || 7
|-
| 2 || +60% || 8
|-
| 3 || +80% || 9
|-
| 4 || +100% || 10
|-
| 5 || +120% || 11
|}

==Acquisition==
*This mod was once acquired by getting 10 Exposure Points in the [[Operation: Gate Crash]] Event.
*Can also be acquired as an end-of-mission reward from accomplishing the Endurance challenge of the [[Tactical Alert#Emergency Exit|Emergency Exit]] Tactical Alert.
*It is offered as a periodic item for sale by Baro Ki'Teer, costing {{dc|375}} and {{cc|150,000}} to purchase. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this mod may not be available on a succeeding appearance.
*It is now available as a possible drop for capturing the [[Eidolon Hydrolyst]].

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Can be combined with {{M|Carnis Stinger}} and {{M|Razor Shot}} to provide a 300% increase to {{D|Slash}} damage.
*When calculating total raw damage, a weapon will require a Slash damage percentage equal to 75% of its total base damage to equal the raw damage increase provided by a standard elemental mod (which increases corresponding elemental damages by 90%). The higher the Slash damage percentage over 75%, the more viable this mod will be as opposed to an elemental mod, and vice versa for lower values. These calculations only pertain to raw damage, and do not take into consideration enemy armor/flesh/shield damage multipliers.
**Due to this comparison, the only secondaries to effectively use Maim as a damage increase mod are {{Weapon|Pyrana}}, {{Weapon|Akjagara Prime}} and {{Weapon|Euphona Prime}}'s secondary shot, as all other weapons have 70% ratio or less.
**{{WF|Titania}}'s {{Weapon|Dex Pixia}} are also able to effectively use this mod, having a ratio of 80% slash.
*That being said, this mod can still be effectively used to increase the chance of slash procs in status builds, given how the type of damage amounts affects the calculations for procs.

{{ver|14.7}}
*Introduced.

{{Top|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.}} The '''Mara Detron''' is a [[Void Trader]]-exclusive variant of the {{Weapon|Detron}} that has altered stats along with a unique animated skin. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Radiation}} damage. *Can use the {{Weapon|Detron}}-exclusive {{M|Thermagnetic Shells}} mod. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun Sidearm| *Very high overall [[status chance]]. *Good [[accuracy]]. *Innate [[multishot]] of 7 pellets. *Fast [[Projectile Speed]]. *Very ammo efficient. *Medium spread. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun Sidearm| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 37.5% from 16m to 30m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Projectiles have travel time. }} {{WeaponComparison|Detron}} {{WeaponComparison|Tenet Detron}} ==Acquisition== *The Mara Detron can be purchased from [[Baro Ki'Teer]] in the Concourse section of the [[Tenno]] [[Relay]] for {{cc|200,000}} and {{dc|500}}. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance. *Like [[Weapon Augments#Syndicate Weapons|Syndicate Weapons]], unranked Mara Detrons without [[Forma]] and [[Orokin Catalyst]]s can be traded between players. ==Tips== *The Mara Detron's increased fire rate means that mods like {{M|Lethal Torrent}} make it fire faster than can be clicked manually. Turning on the fire manual trigger weapons continuously setting can alleviate this. *The Mara Detron is a secondary shotgun so Multishot mods {{M|Lethal Torrent}} and {{M|Barrel Diffusion}} will increase the pellet count. *As the Mara Detron is essentially an improved {{Weapon|Detron}}, refer to the [[Detron#Tips|Detron's Tips]] for more upgrade/optimization possibilities. ==Trivia== *The Mara Detron can be visually identified from the standard Detron by the diffuse cloud textured animation on its body. **This animated texture is based off the weapon's energy color, and thus can be changed to match any hue the user wishes for. **As with the [[Syndicate|Syndicate reward weapons]], when the Mara Detron is stolen by a [[Drahk Master]] it will appear as a regular {{Weapon|Detron}} on the ground and will revert to its Mara variant when picked up. *The Mara Detron has a distinct sound when fired, closer to traditional shotguns than the energy-based weapons regularly used by the Corpus. *Despite being from the Orokin Era, it does not appear to be manufactured by the [[Orokin]]. As a smuggler's weapon, it may be implied this weapon was designed outside of their authority. It might similarly be speculated this could be a clue to the very early origins of the [[Corpus]]. **This is reinforced by [[Parvos Granum]]'s origin. Being the founder of the Corpus, and known to live during the time of the Orokin while being accompanied by an officially-assigned [[Protea|Warframe]]. He mentions that the Corpus board of directors sabotaged his ship, sending him to the Granum Void long ago. Likely meaning the Corpus were already well-established in the Origin System during Orokin rule. *The Mara Detron ejects its magazine when reloading. **Oddly, however, it reverts to its default colors (black with orange lights) when ejected, rather than any applied custom colors. *The flowing effect on the weapon is similar to the flowing effect on Steam's [[Phased Skins]] promotional items, as well as the [[Prisma]] weapons that [[Baro Ki'Teer/Current PC Items|Baro]] also occasionally sells, only reddish-orange instead of sea-green or bluish-cyan, respectively. **This may possibly imply that the weapon uses Prisma crystals in its construction, or a similar material, given its similarities to a Prisma weapon. *The Mara Detron was leaked as an entry in a player's Profile under ''Equipment'', along with the {{Weapon|Imperator Vandal}}, before it was revealed to be sold by the Void Trader Baro Ki'Teer. *Mara is a Hebrew female adjective, meaning ''bitter''. **It is also a word in the in-universe language of [[Voidtongue]], introduced long after this weapon. *This is currently the first and only Mara-type weapon. Despite this, however, both the statistic and visual enhancements are extremely similar to a Prisma weapon. *On [[Baro Ki'Teer|Baro]]'s 50th visit, this item could be purchased at half price for {{cc|100,000}} and {{dc|250}}. {{SkinGallery}} ==Media== MaraDetronCodex2.png|Mara Detron in the Codex {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|m9X3qEUNF2I|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|e5hqzXvK-xU|size=300px}} }} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|41.0.3}} *Fixed the Mara Detron being listed as a Primary weapon in Baro Ki'Teer's wares. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 20 Ammo per Pick Up: *Mara Detron {{ver|27.4}} *Cleaned up FX to improve performance with the Mara Detron, and tweaked their projectile lifetime to 3-5 seconds. {{ver|27.2}} ;Greater than 100% Status having meaning: Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case. Shotguns as a special case means we have buffed the Status Chance of all Shotguns by x3 or greater. The UI now behaves to show the reality that you are determining Status Chance per pellet. *(Undocumented) Status chance per projectile increased from {{#expr: 32/7}}% to {{#expr: 32/7 * 3}}%. {{ver|25.7}} *Fixed the FX on the edge of the War fading out very quickly if the Mara Detron is equipped. {{ver|25.0.4}} *Fixed Mara Detron projectile firing incorrectly when in Glaive+Gun mode. {{ver|22.13.1}} *Fixed numerous projectile weapons (Detron, etc) having incorrect Status Chance calculations. {{ver|22.12}} *Damage increased from 30 to 40 (per pellet). *Status chance increased from 20% to 32%. *Critical chance increased from 5% to 8%. *Fire rate decreased. {{ver|21}} *Damage increased from 20 to 30. *Damage fall off added starting from 16m and ending at 32 with a minimum damage of 15. *Status Chance increased from 10% to 20%. *Critical chance increased from 2.5% to 5%. *Increased Accuracy for hip and aimed fire. *Mastery Rank 9 required. {{ver|19.8.1}} *Fixed the Detron Mara having the name switched as Mara Detron. {{ver|18.0}} *Detron series now available for use in Conclave. {{ver|15.6.3}} *Introduced to Baro Ki'Teer's rotating stock. }}{{ver/Lu|23.6.2}} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Detron}}, the normal counterpart of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Tenet Detron}}, the [[Tenet]] counterpart of this weapon. *[[Baro Ki'Teer]], the vendor who can sell the weapon. {{VoidTraderNav}} {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Mara Detron]] [[es:Detron Mara]] [[fr:Detron Mara]] [[ru:Мара Детрон]] [[Category:Corpus]] [[Category:Single Sidearm]] [[Category:Radiation Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Secondary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Update 15]] [[Category:Baro Ki'Teer Offering]] [[Category:Special Weapons]] [[uk:Детрон-мара]]

==Notes==
*Cannot produce multiple procs in a single instance of damage alongside any other {{D|Magnetic}} sources such as a weapon's innate {{D|Magnetic}}.
*Proccing {{D|Impact}} more than once in a single instance of damage will not allow this mod to proc more than once, nor will it increase the chance of the mod proccing.
*{{M|Hard Engage}} works with this mod.
*[[Fire Rate]] buffs such as {{WF|Gauss}}' {{A|Redline}}, {{WF|Wisp}}'s Haste {{A|Reservoirs}}, and  {{Arcane|Arcane Tempo}} can negatively impact this mod's performance since it may increase the weapon's fire rate past 2.5.
* If the weapon's fire rate is exactly 2.5, it will '''not''' receive the 2x bonus.

==Tips==
*Shotguns with very high {{D|Impact}} Damage & Status Chance include:
** {{Weapon|Boar}} ({{Weapon|Boar Prime|Prime}})
** {{Weapon|Sobek}} ({{Weapon|Kuva Sobek|Kuva}})
** {{Weapon|Strun}} ({{Weapon|Mk1-Strun|Mk1}}, {{Weapon|Strun Wraith|Wraith}}, {{Weapon|Strun Prime|Prime}})
*Shotguns with a '''guaranteed''' {{D|Impact}} Status Effect include:
**{{Weapon|Astilla}} ({{Weapon|Astilla Prime|Prime}}) (on direct hit)
**{{Weapon|Arca Plasmor}} ({{Weapon|Tenet Arca Plasmor|Tenet}}) (within 14 meters of the enemy)
**{{Weapon|Catchmoon (Primary)|Catchmoon}} (within 10 meters of the enemy)
**{{Weapon|Corinth}} ({{Weapon|Corinth Prime|Prime}}) (Alt-fire direct hit)
**{{Weapon|Phantasma}} ({{Weapon|Phantasma Prime|Prime}}) (Alt-fire direct hit, projectiles)
*{{M|Critical Deceleration}} and {{M|Tainted Shell}} have ''potential'' synergy with this mod, due to their [[fire rate]] penalty reducing fire rate below 2.5 on some weapons.

==Trivia==
*A [[:wikipedia:Welt (bruise)|welt]] is a type of bruise, often as a result of impact from an elongated object without any sharp edges.
